title: Veggie Egg Burritos
subtitle: Peppers, spinach, and eggs wrapped for the vegetarian on shift.
description: Peppers, spinach, and scrambled eggs in flour tortillas — vegetarian option that still feeds the line with real flavor and hot sauce.

ingredients.name: large eggs
ingredients.notes: whisked with a pinch of salt

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Veggie Egg Burritos in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Eggs. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Crisp the potatoes
steps.instruction: Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium-high. Add hash browns in an even layer; press with a spatula. Let them sit until browned, flip in sections, and season with salt and pepper. Move to a warm tray.

steps.title: Brown the meat + veg
steps.instruction: In the same pan, brown sausage/chorizo. Add onion and peppers; cook until softened. Drain excess fat if needed so burritos don’t get greasy.

steps.title: Soft-scramble the eggs
steps.instruction: Lower heat to medium. Add a touch of butter, then the eggs. Stir gently until just set (slightly glossy). Fold in cheese off heat so it melts without overcooking.

steps.title: Build and wrap for the line
steps.instruction: Warm tortillas briefly. Add potatoes, meat/veg, eggs, and a spoon of salsa. Roll tight: fold sides, then roll forward. Hold wrapped burritos seam-side down on a warm sheet pan.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Serve + hold
steps.instruction: Keep burritos warm in a 200°F oven (uncovered for crispy tortillas; covered for softer). If you’re feeding in waves, build half, serve, then build the rest.

stationWorkflow: Assign one cook to the hot surface and one to assembly. Keep the line moving; don’t crowd the griddle.
Set a warm holding zone (oven 200°F or covered hotel pan) so staggered eaters still get a hot plate.
Run a quick call-proof check: anything crispy stays uncovered; anything soft stays covered.
cleanupNotes: While plates are served, scrape the griddle/pan and wipe with a damp towel (use tongs + folded towel).
Soak the mixing bowl and sheet pan immediately—breakfast starch sets fast when it cools.
leftovers: Cool fast: spread on a sheet pan 10 minutes, then portion into containers so it doesn’t sweat.
Reheat rule: eggs reheat best covered at 50% power or low oven heat; don’t nuke on high.
